readiness: must depend on frozen/qualified/replay lease, RF/time/latency/profile safety; Fine/DMA readiness is explicitly excluded
fraction: fraction_q32==0 required; nonzero reject before reader admission; fractional_supported runtime input removed or tied to unsupported capability
profile: RX calibration ID, target matrix ID and Doppler phase ID pinned; no FD phase/version fields in active match
stream: A-port RAW -> RXCAL -> target; no FD zero flush
latency: digital and physical latency must be retabled; latency_validated remains external false until evidence exists
ownership: RAW replay token retires after final A-port read; TX processing/profile lifetime may extend through downstream tail; independent Fine/upload refs cannot be cleared by replay token
